title: Dexcom G5: Periodical interrupt of connection
symptom: Periodical interrupts of connection and data is missing. The connection drops consistently and restarting the collector brings it back. While the phone's display is on sleep mode or screen lock, the capture rate is approx. 10%.
cause: The Huawei issue is likely to be due to its non-standard power saving features, such as 'Protected Apps' which is like the battery optimization whitelist.
fix: Either disabling the power saving feature or adding xDrip to its whitelist can help.
evidence_quote: I think the Huawei issue is likely to be due to its non-standard power saving features. I think it has a concept of something called "Protected Apps" which is like the battery optimization whitelist. I don't think we have a way to control this programatically, but either disabling it or adding xDrip to its whitelist can help I think.
